# Section 04 Highlights

## Highlight 1
**Headline:** 190 visible products have no price — directly blocking sales for 11.8% of the rep-facing catalog
**Context:** These products are visible to reps but cannot be ordered. An additional 323 products are missing images (20%). Overall visible catalog completeness is 68.2%. Addressing priceless items should be the immediate priority.
**Section:** [§4 Product & Inventory Intelligence](#product)
**Priority Action Candidate:** YES
**Urgency:** HIGH — Revenue is being directly blocked; every day these remain priceless is a missed selling opportunity.

## Highlight 2
**Headline:** Nuage collection dominates at $621K — nearly double the #2 collection (Dana at $313K)
**Context:** Nuage is the franchise collection with 13 SKUs generating $47,767 per SKU. The Modena collection achieves even higher efficiency at $63,894/SKU with only 4 products. Targa generates $96,845 from a single SKU — the highest single-SKU productivity.
**Section:** [§4 Product & Inventory Intelligence](#product)

## Highlight 3
**Headline:** All 20 top-selling products show zero on-hand inventory — consistent with made-to-order model
**Context:** The top sellers (Modena Classic Swivel Chair at $192K, Nuage Swivel Chair at $126K) all show 0 available and 0 on hand. Combined with an 83.8% order fill rate and 809 unfilled items, this pattern suggests lead-time communication is critical for rep-customer conversations.
**Section:** [§4 Product & Inventory Intelligence](#product)
